Loop Registry: the engineer's path

Today the title carries a ? with the readiness sentence; a Configuration limits line holds three counts as links ("234 valve positions expected but not mapped · 239 peer links expected but missing · 241 degraded") and a second ?; the list card has its own title "Loop assets", a count note "243 loops", a Show retired box and Find loop last; the pager reads "← Prev · Page 1 of 10 · Next →". A row replaces the list with the loop's own page under the same header: "‹ Loop Registry", a second title FIC10401 with Edit configuration and Retire, three links, then Facts (nine rows), Signal mapping, Readiness and Loop model with Re-project. On that page the missing VP is said three times (Valve position row, Observability pill, Readiness check) and the missing peer links three times. The editor is four steps with an eyebrow, the tag in its title, "Step 1 of 4", five paragraphs of explanation and a closed disclosure; Bulk import names its step twice and counts the same rows three times, and its row status is cut off at the right. The page answers two questions, which loops are set up and ready, and how this one is set up, and holds three tasks: add, import, edit or retire. So the list finds the loop, the panel says how it is set up and whether it is ready and holds its actions, and the editors stay dialogs with tabs, because each is a sequence.

Header

What is this page, and how do I read its words?
  • Set up · Loop Registry, no ?, no sentence under it
  • How to read: State, VP, Readiness in aligned columns (the two ? of today)
  • Bulk import and Add loop top right; without cpm.manage each says why under it

Find

Which loop, and which loops are not ready?
  • Search first: loop, service, site, area, unit or type
  • One dropdown: Not retired 243 · With retired 243 · VP expected, not mapped 234 · Peer links expected, missing 239 · Degraded 241
  • Rows: tag over service, ○ Not monitored or ⊘ Retired only when abnormal; Loop type; VP
  • 25 a page, the shared pager, centred

Selected loop

How is this loop set up?
  • Heading: FIC10401, Flow controller (FCS0101), ! Degraded
  • Plant path, Loop type, Criticality, Gate profile, Model
  • Record details (dialog): objective · topology · command, acquisition, how the model was set

Readiness and signals

Is it ready to be evaluated, and which signals feed it?
  • Valve position (G14) and Peer links (G13), the server's advice behind each ?
  • Any other check not met, by name with its message (Loop type (UNKNOWN), Diagnosis produced …)
  • Signals: PV, SP, OP, MODE (VP) with their pen colour, the path under the plant path, Copy; a required role not mapped says so

Change it

What do I do about it?
  • Edit configuration: Identity → Classification → Signals → Review, Next: X →; the changes with their effect; the readiness after saving
  • Retire (a reason) / Restore; Re-project links & republish evidence with its receipt
  • Each disabled action says why
  • Workbench ↗, Effective rules ↗, Plant tree ↗; the foot: Loop Explorer →

Bulk import

How do I register many loops at once?
  • File: Download template, choose, drop or paste, edit in place
  • Review: the counts once; Status before the paths, so the reason a row fails is in view
  • Activate: allow unmodelled locations, Activate 2 loops; failures first, Fix and re-import

What stays exactly

The address?loop= ?search= ?page= ?retired=1 ?gap=vp|peers|degraded; Back returns to the same list; a new site, area or unit starts at page 1
The list25 a page, in the registry's order; search over tag, service, site, area, unit and type; the plant scope from the header
ColumnsLoop (tag, then the service without the repeated tag), Loop type, VP (Mapped / Not mapped / No VP); a badge only on Not monitored and Retired rows
CountsVP and peer counts from the fleet summary, Degraded counted from the list, all within the plant scope
Loop factsPlant path, type, criticality, gate profile, model, objective · topology · command, acquisition, how the model was set, valve position, peer links, other observability flags, a retired loop's open episode, every readiness check not met with its message, signal paths with Copy and Copied / Copy failed
PermissionsAdd loop, Bulk import, Edit configuration, Retire / Restore, Re-project need cpm.manage, the reason under each ("Needs the cpm.manage permission", "Restore the loop first"); Effective rules ↗ needs cpm.config.read; Plant tree ↗ the plant tree
ReceiptsRetired / Restored / Republished FIC10401 by whom and when, the links and signal assets, or why it failed
Editor fields and rulesEvery field and list; the tag rules (duplicate, forbidden characters, historian collision); required service and site; Enter manually and the unmodelled override; the five model selects with their preset; acquisition mode and four numbers; paths derived and overridable, + add VP, path checks (space, control character, dotted root.… form, a stored path kept with a warning); ranges (both bounds or neither, max above min, unit characters); VP and interacting loops; changes with their effect; the window contract; Update loop / Activate loop; the readiness after saving
Bulk importTemplate; .csv up to 2 MB; choose, drop or paste and edit in place; quoted cells and # comments; every row check and warning; 100 rows previewed, all validated; 5,000 per import in one request; allow unmodelled locations; failures first; Fix and re-import
Retire / RestoreReason required up to 500 characters (optional on Restore); the error stays in the dialog with the typed reason; history stays
StatesLoading, "Registry unavailable" with Retry, "Configuration limits unavailable" with Retry (beside the dropdown), readiness unavailable with Retry
SizesTwo-line rows and type as today; 40 px header buttons, editor fields and panel actions; 32 px filter row and pager

For the owner to decide

  1. The loop's page becomes a panel beside the list? Today a row replaces the list with a page of its own under the list's header (two titles, ‹ Loop Registry). Recommended: the panel, as Loop Events and Calculations, a drawer below 1280 px; ?loop= stays. No backend change.
  2. One dropdown for Show retired and the three limit counts? The counts leave the always-visible line and live in the dropdown that filters by them (each was on screen twice once chosen: "234 valve positions…" and "234 loops"). Recommended: yes. No backend change.
  3. Signal paths under the plant path ("…/fic10401.pv")? Each full path repeats the 56-character plant path. Recommended: yes, the whole path on hover and in Copy. The other way: full paths on two lines.
  4. Ranges on the Signals tab? PV range and unit scale the PV, OP range normalises the OP; today they sit on Classification with the model. Recommended: yes, beside the paths.
  5. The first loop selected when the address names none? Loop Events and Calculations select the first row (one readiness read); the alternative is "Choose a loop in the list" until a click. Recommended: the first row, as the other pages.
  6. Editor steps as tabs with "Next: X →", titled "Edit configuration" / "Add loop"? Forward still only through Next; back any time. Recommended: yes.
  7. A Monitored switch in the editor? A loop's monitoring cannot be switched anywhere in the UI: the editor sends back what is stored, and only a bulk import of the same tag turns it on. The readiness of a not-monitored loop says "Re-activate with enableMonitoring=true." Adds a capability; the request already carries it, so no backend change. Recommended: yes, under Classification › Ranking; drawn dashed.
  8. Valve position as three choices? The checkbox saves Expected or Not applicable only; Not installed (a valve without positioner feedback: a valve cause is suspected, not confirmed) comes only from a CSV, and an edit keeps it. Recommended: a dropdown Expected / Not installed / Not applicable in place of the checkbox (UI only), and Interacting loops without "Not installed". Not drawn.
  9. Export CSV? There is no export today, only the import template. An export of the list in the import format would let a plant correct many loops and import them back. Adds a capability, client side, no backend change. Recommended: yes; drawn dashed in the filter row.
  10. Keep "Re-project links & republish evidence" long? The server's peer-links advice names it word for word. Recommended: keep it.

  • Editor › Classification: "OP rangenormalises": the space after the bold "OP range" is lost.
  • The same loop reads "Not monitored" in the list and "Registered" on its page (EVAPI_12F4CB).
  • "Retire loop" is disabled until a reason is typed, with nothing saying so.
  • Add loop: before a site is picked, Area and Unit read "— no areas modelled —" and "— no units modelled —".
  • Editor › Signals: the empty VP field shows the derived path as a grey placeholder that reads as a value, beside "+ add VP as" the same path.
  • The readiness read answered HTTP 500 once (FIC10401); the page then stayed on "Checking readiness…" while it retried. The next read worked.
  • Lab facts: every monitored loop is Degraded (241 of 241: 234 without a VP, 239 without peer links); there is no Active and no retired loop, so those states are illustrative. Loops whose preset has no family read "Model — · —" and "UNSET · UNKNOWN · UNKNOWN" (AIC30601, G13_LOOP_A, EVAPI_*).
  • A readiness message names an engine topic ("No samples have reached traverse.cpa.loop.samples.v1 for this loop yet."); server text, not changed here.
